race.description: Sportsbet Same Race Multi Mdn Plate
race.comment: SUPER WONDER (10) was well supported on debut off the back of some sharp jumpouts but folded up quickly at Morphetville Parks after leading them up. Has been gelded during the break and has trialled sharply under Harry Grace. Expecting him to hit the ground running this time. SETTLE PETAL (8) only warmed late fresh behind a handy maiden winner then finished much closer her last time. Peaking now and gets the blinkers applied. Can give this a big shake. PRETTY MORSEL (6) has found the maiden win elusive but has a handful of efforts littered through her form that can measure up. Has had a good blow-out in readiness and should be making her presence felt. ZEREALM (4) is a five-year-old Overshare entire on debut for the Murtagh stable. Has come along well in his lead-up work and can play a role. SPARTAN LASS (9) is the first runner to step out for the Indianna Weinert stable in SA. Looks a speedy mare that can take up the running.
